title: The Yellow House
suread_note: 只读 text/ 完成，未打开该章 md。

facts.fact: 本章双时间线抬头：2034 年 5 月 2 日（Alba 32 岁）与 2007 年 2 月 27 日（Alba 5 岁，Clare 35 岁）。
黄房子的位置与外观：芝加哥普通维多利亚式木屋，几乎就在 Ravenswood 高架线下方，Metra 铁轨在街对面，没有一处是直的。
facts.quote: It is almost underneath the Ravenswood El, and the Metra train tracks are across the street.
facts.anchor: It is almost underneath the Ravenswood

facts.fact: 房子来路：地址写在纸条上、毫无解释地订在父亲遗嘱里；母亲到市政厅查产权，发现 Alba 自 1947 年起就是房主。
facts.quote: When she looked up the deed at City Hall she found that I had been the owner of the Yellow House since 1947.
facts.anchor: When she looked up the deed

facts.fact: 2007-02-27 母女进房：前门按铃无人应，后门未锁；厨房白红两色、镀铬像 1950 年代餐馆，桌上有一只写着 Welcome, Alba! 的蛋糕。
facts.quote: In the middle of the kitchen table was a cake, white icing with shaky red letters on top.
facts.anchor: In the middle of the kitchen

facts.fact: 括注交代蛋糕来历：Oliver 烤的蛋糕、Alba 抹的糖霜；两人喝醉，Oliver 坚持收拾干净以防明早人不在，还花十分钟把蛋糕摆正，凌晨三点才睡。
facts.quote: Oliver baked that cake and I frosted it. We were pretty drunk by the time the cake was done
facts.anchor: Oliver baked that cake and I

facts.fact: Mama 对 5 岁的 Alba 说：这房子属于你，甚至在你出生前就属于你；又说也许未来的你有时会住在这里。
facts.quote: “This house belongs to you, Alba. It belonged to you even before you were born.”
facts.anchor: This house belongs to you Alba

facts.fact: 熊：Mama 先答应让带走又改口“留在这儿”，随后说“去爱他吧”，Alba 摇头没拿；熊叫 Other Teddy，成了她穿越回这房子的“门”，一次次救她免于迷失、受冻、赤身落在陌生处。
facts.quote: The bear’s name was Other Teddy. He became a kind of doorway into the house

facts.fact: 最后一间卧室：提琴尺寸太大、走音但是好琴；衣柜门关着，门把上方装了一把吓人的大挂锁；Alba 说“那里面关着所有怪物”。
facts.quote: A large, ominous-looking padlock had been installed above the doorknob.
facts.quote2: “That’s where they keep all the monsters,” I said.

facts.fact: 临走：Mama 让 Alba 留下点东西，Alba 留下树莓色厚羊毛手套、按她的便条摆好，Mama 把自己的皮手套给她；两人确保门都不上锁；Mama 报出日期 2007-02-27，事后 Alba 明白那是在给她“时间地标、导航坐标”。
facts.quote: Later I realized that Mama was trying to give me temporal landmarks, coordinates to navigate by.
facts.anchor: Later I realized that Mama was
facts.quote2: I pulled off the mittens and carefully arranged them by her note

facts.fact: 第二场 2007-03-07（Alba 25 岁、Oliver 44 岁）：Alba 进厨房，Oliver 正在读母亲写给她的信，说“忍不住”；信里母亲问要不要照看房子，PS 问“另一间卧室里是谁的衣服？”
facts.quote2: PS: Whose clothes are in the other bedroom?

facts.fact: Alba 脱口说“读你自己的信”，随即捂嘴——Oliver 的父母在他还是少年时就死在中国了，没有父母给他写信；Oliver 说“我很嫉妒”。
facts.quote: Oliver has no parents to write letters to him; they died back in China, while he was still a teenager.
facts.anchor: Oliver has no parents to write

facts.fact: Oliver 与 Alba 母亲唯一一次接触：在超市帮她把卡在一起的两辆购物车分开，她道谢后推车进店继续买东西；他说这是与她母亲“最复杂的互动”。
facts.quote: I once helped her disengage a grocery cart that was stuck together with another grocery cart.

facts.fact: Oliver 说自己最终会见到她家人：从没见过她父亲，但和 Beck 相处不少时间；Alba 惊问“Beck？为什么？”，Oliver 答“你知道的。原因。”并说 Alba 有点把 Beck 当成理所当然。
facts.quote: I’ve never met your dad, but Beck and I spend a fair amount of time together.
facts.anchor: I’ve never met your dad but
facts.quote2: You take Beck for granted a bit, I think.

turning_point: 本章转折点已进：Mama 在 2007 年就把“房子属于你、出生前就属于你”和“2007-02-27”这个日期交给 5 岁的 Alba（line 137/274），这是她日后穿越导航的支点；另加一条未进 5–8 条的补充：成年 Alba 从 Oliver 口中第一次得知他会与 Beck 长期往来（line 337），埋下她对 Beck 位置的警觉。
